title: The Ignored Replace
description: censor(text, word) replaces every occurrence of word with asterisks of the same length.
solution:
def censor(text, word):
    return text.replace(word, "*" * len(word))
hint: Does `str.replace` change the string, or give you a new one?
explanation: Strings are immutable in Python. `replace` returns a new string and leaves the original alone. The result was thrown away. Return (or assign) the value that `replace` gives back.
